notes: «قالا حدثنا ابن وهب» converges the two branches; both branches write their names to مخرمة, and the names the text writes once after the last ح (أبيه onward) form the shared tail.
«مولى ابن عباس» describes Kurayb and is left out.
The Prophet's wife Maymuna is the last link; the saying is hers.
